inspiration: Hit location as a skeleton profile: a creature has a bone set and each bone has its own attack modifier table; non-creature targets always use the default location. Frankendom: per-creature regions with their own armour mods, not six bones.
Damage as a list of typed attribute modifiers: one hit becomes a list of mods, health loss is one mod with a direct-damage flag and pool decay. Frankendom: lets sustain, decay and armour stack later.
Attacks as queued actions: the attack command is queued on the creature with the weapon and mode, and aim is its own queued entry. Frankendom: aim and strike as ordered entries the server checks.
Per-AI threat table: each AI keeps target to hate values, the highest current value becomes the target, and pets pass hate to their owner with a zero entry.
Target expiry and leash: the primary target clears after a period with no activity; leash time and forced target are exposed (bodies not read).
Designer-tunable threat through a script bridge: add hate, add hate over time, aggro immunity per player and reset timer are callable from data.

briefs.label: Threat ladder (aggro ledger)
briefs.why: a boss reads its target from a visible value and the top slot changes as players fight, which gives the fight a story
keep: top target re-picks from the table over time
pet or summon feeds the owner with a zero entry
change: cap the table at MAX_ATTACKERS of 3
show threat as a ring colour on the enemy, not a number
a taunt that moves one slot up

briefs.label: Segmented hit regions
briefs.why: a hit on a shield arm feels different from a hit on the head because the region picks the armour that answers
keep: hit region index passed into damage
regions that do not exist on a target fall back to a default
change: per-creature regions such as crest, shield arm and tail instead of six bones

briefs.label: Aim then strike queue
briefs.why: a readable wind-up that the server checks in order makes ranged fights feel deliberate
keep: aim is a queued action before the attack
change: aim is a stance that builds a charge shown on the lock-on ring
typed payload instead of packed string

briefs.label: Typed damage mod list

change: mods drive hitstop and the finisher window directly
